fit_scope: Only source-training e/C/I hidden features and known e<->C/e<->I edges. Hyperparameters use existing known-state validation, with matched correct/shuffled supervision; no hidden states or answers in map fit or selection.
diagnostic_scope: Teacher forcing uses true intermediate states ONLY to localize error, and is never counted as a hidden-relation predictor. Correct and shuffled maps use exactly the same frozen backbone and readout. Source grades are identical within that comparison.
